description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haragama, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
